title: Scrolling table with a sticky header
summary: A scroll box with a sticky header row; the header needs its own background and a z-index to stay readable.
explanation: The scroll box has a fixed height and overflow: auto, so the whole table scrolls inside it. The header row is position: sticky with top: 0, so it stays at the top while the rows slide under it.

Sticky cells need a solid background and z-index: 1, or the rows would show through the header as they scroll past. Each cell also gets a min-width so long columns stay readable and the row scrolls sideways when needed.
tryThis: Remove background from .head: the rows show through the header as you scroll.
Remove position: sticky from .head: the header scrolls away with the rest.
Set overflow to hidden on .scroller: you can no longer scroll to the lower rows.
